definitions.definition: (revenue - cost of goods sold - SG&A - interest expense) / book equity, fiscal year t-1, formed each June
definitions.gap: Operating income already deducts COGS and SG&A, but interest expense is not deducted (no interest-expense field in the PIT store); TTM rather than fiscal-year t-1; refreshed per filing rather than each June.

definitions.definition: (revenue - cost of goods sold) / total assets
definitions.gap: Neither store collects cost of goods sold or gross profit (US FLOWS and KR WANTED_ACCOUNTS list revenue, operating income, net income, equity, liabilities, assets, operating cash flow, capex). Operating income also deducts SG&A, which Novy-Marx deliberately does not; this is a different measure (closer to operating profitability / assets), not a weaker version of GP/A.

definitions.definition: net income (TTM) / book equity among large caps with operating margin > 0 and liabilities/equity <= 2
definitions.gap: Bottom-line and levered: includes interest, taxes, non-operating and one-off items, and rises with leverage (the <= 2 cap limits but does not remove that). It is an in-house proxy motivated by the profitability literature, NOT a reproduction of either academic strategy.

b1v2DryRun.rule:
B1_PROFITABILITY_V2 (prospective): stage-3 survivors, inputs from ONE complete filing (complete_filing),
large cap, operating margin > 0, liabilities/equity <= 2, ranked by ROE. OI/BE and OI/A are computed from
the same filing and reported beside ROE, never used to rank.

branches.b1: stages 6-8 are computed from stage 4 independently of stage 5
branches.factorReference: stage 5 is computed from stage 4 for information only and feeds nothing
branches.main: stages 0-4 drop names; stage 4 = factor-complete set

dropSides.method: Classified from the latest filing visible on the as-of date and its derivation flags; a name absent from the store altogether was never collected. INCOMPLETE_CHAIN cannot tell an account the filer omitted from one the collector's exact-label match dropped (AGENTS v2.33), so it stays unresolved.

periods.freshnessRule: each field's report period must end within 456 days of the as-of date; the filing must be visible by its receipt date (availableFrom)

shareCounts.affects: bookToPrice and every per-share figure; ROE, margins and liabilities/equity are ratios of totals and are unaffected
shareCounts.pipelineNote: Fixing the carry rule belongs to the shared pipeline (finnhub_derive.carried_shares), which this research branch does not modify.
shareCounts.rule: a per-share field is invalid when its share count was carried forward more than 456 days
